text: Bring the cube. Do not lose the cube. You will lose the cube.
Five chambers done. I would tell you how many are left, but it would only discourage you.
This chamber uses everything so far: the cube, the light, the field, and the sentries, who have been waiting.
Do not worry about that one. The next you is already on the way.
You have disabled a sentry. It will lie there sulking for the rest of the test.
The receiver is lit. That is the first thing in here you have made happy.
Click once and your aim locks to the centre of the screen. Then slide on the trackpad to look around, and swipe with two fingers to walk. Click for a blue portal, and two finger click for orange.
The left stick walks, and the right stick looks. The left trigger or bumper fires blue, and the right one fires orange. Select shows every button.
You are the most promising subject I have tested today. You are also the only one.
